_note: Reference set labels: 10 real playbooks from the public playbook collection, 12 constraints each, 120 decisions, 53 labelled as violated. Labels were assigned by the author as domain expert, with a written reason for each violation and notes on the decisions that were not violated; labels marked GREY are the ones the author regards as borderline. Conventions fixed before any accuracy was computed: (1) 'not violated' covers a satisfied constraint and one that does not apply; (2) a playbook is a response playbook if it contains a containment or destructive action, and most constraints do not apply to playbooks without one; (3) C07 is violated when a governed action fails to execute (missing integration or error) and the flow ends with no escalation or notification; exits caused only by missing input do not count; (4) C10 is violated whenever response actions occur with no log or telemetry collection task. 'injected' lists violations introduced by a recorded modification of the original playbook (see MODIFICATION_LOG.md); the rest are present in the original.

rationale.C01: Introduced by the recorded modification: original playbook gated file deletion, process termination and password reset behind manual/auto decision conditions (tasks 14, 15, 21) and analyst data-collection tasks; modification removed all gates so all three destructive actions execute unconditionally from start.
rationale.C02: Present in the original: file deletion (core-run-script-delete-file) executes with no preceding evidence-capture or sample-preservation task; true of the original as well.
rationale.C03: Present in the original: no task records actions taken or updates an incident record.
rationale.C04: Present in the original: no notification task to any stakeholder despite password resets and file deletions affecting users.
rationale.C05: Present in the original: no triage/severity assessment precedes eradication actions; the removed gates asked whether to run each action, not an assessment of the event.
rationale.C06: Present in the original: no post-incident review or lessons-learned step.
rationale.not_violated_notes: C08 not violated (actions target the single host and user of the incident, not a wide scope); C09 names are descriptive; C11 and C12 not applicable (no restoration; no manual decision points remain).
rationale.C07: [42] 'Is AD enabled?' exits to Done — password reset silently not executed when the integration is absent. Convention: violated when a governed action fails to execute (missing integration/error) and the flow ends with no escalation or notification; pure no-input exits do not count.
rationale.C10: no log/telemetry collection task. Convention (strict): response actions with no log/telemetry-collection task = violated.

rationale.C01: Introduced by the recorded modification: original asked whether files should be auto-allowlisted (condition 2) with a manual exception path (task 4); modification removed both, so files are added to the allow list and exclusions created with no human approval - a protection-weakening action class.
rationale.C07: Introduced by the recorded modification: original asked whether the alert should be closed automatically (condition 9); modification removed it, so alerts are always auto-closed as false positive with no analyst review pathway - handling terminates without any human escalation.
rationale.C06: Present in the original: no feedback or review step captures why the false positive occurred (e.g. detection-tuning lessons), so recurring FP causes are never learned from.
rationale.not_violated_notes: C03 not violated (the closeInvestigation action itself constitutes a recorded closure); C04 not applicable to false-positive closure; C05 not violated (the playbook's premise is a prior false-positive judgement supplied as input); C02, C08 and C11 not applicable (no evidence-destroying, wide-scope or restoration action); C12 not applicable (no manual decision points remain).
rationale.C10: exclusion/allow-list actions with no log collection. Convention (strict): response actions with no log/telemetry-collection task = violated.
